specification.problem: Grover search on 4 qubits (N=16) with one marked basis state w, as an ideal gate-level unitary that includes the initial Hadamard layer, with an optional second-neighbour ZZ phase layer standing in for the nuclear-spin-chain Ising couplings.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Ideal Grover algorithm on 4 qubits with k=3 iterations. The unitary built from |0000> includes H^{\otimes 4} as its first layer. An optional ZZ_{j,j+2} phase layer follows each Grover iteration. The pulse-level Hamiltonian, the Rabi-frequency scan and the 2πk-condition maxima are outside this scope. No query complexity is claimed and the oracle is compiled from the explicit w.

symbols.domain: integer in 0..15, assumed w=5 unless specified

symbols.meaning: bit j of x, on qubit q_j

equations.label: Uniform initial state
equations.description: State preparation. The built unitary must start with H on all four qubits. q0 is the least significant bit.
equations.justification: Standard Grover initialisation. The reviewer found the Hadamard layer missing in a previous build, so it is now mandatory in the circuit.

equations.label: Oracle and diffusion
equations.description: Phase oracle and inversion about the mean; one Grover iteration.
equations.justification: Standard Grover search. The abstract names the algorithm but gives no equations.
assumptions: Oracle compiled from the explicit w

equations.label: Gate decomposition
equations.description: X^{\bar w} applies X to the qubits where w has a 0 bit. The diffusion circuit equals D up to a global phase of -1.

equations.label: Iteration count and success probability
equations.description: Exact for ideal gates, evaluated at N=16, k=3. k is fixed at 3 for this instance; do not use floor(x) as a general substitute.

equations.label: Fidelity and optional ZZ error layer
equations.description: Fidelity after each Grover iteration. E_phi is an optional second-neighbour ZZ layer applied after each G; as RZZ(angle)=exp(-i angle ZZ/2), the angle is phi/2.
equations.justification: The abstract mentions fidelity and second-nearest-neighbour Ising interactions. The error layer is a proposed simplification, not the paper's model.
assumptions: The error is a pure ZZ phase layer

registers.name: q
registers.role: spin-chain qubits q0..q3; q0 is the least significant bit; all are data qubits, no ancillas

steps.description: Apply H to all 4 qubits to prepare |s>. This layer is part of the built unitary.
Repeat k=3 times: apply O_w, then D, then optionally E_phi (phi=0 by default).
Optionally record F_t after each iteration from the simulated state.

specification.measurement: Measure all qubits in the computational basis and read x=sum x_j 2^j. The circuit is measurement-free, so measurement is applied outside it.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Output x as the candidate marked element w. Success probability is about 0.961 for phi=0.
assumptions: Marked state w is an explicit instance parameter, assumed w=5 (binary 0101) unless specified
The Hamiltonian-level pulse model is not reproduced
n=4 matches the abstract's four-spin simulation
missing_information: Actual spin-chain Hamiltonian parameters and coupling values
The marked state used in the paper
